panel.title: Personalized proactive recommendations
panel.subtitle: See what NEKO uses, what it selected, and why each proactive conversation was allowed or blocked.
panel.alert.disabled: The plugin is disabled: it will not analyze new conversations or make NEKO speak. Configure the rules, then observe results in shadow mode first.
panel.alert.shadow: Shadow mode is observing: interests and candidates are updated, but NEKO will not actually speak.
panel.alert.live: Live mode is active. Content reaches NEKO only after privacy, activity, quiet-hour, frequency, and relevance gates pass.
panel.config.safeTip: Keep shadow mode on first, review the candidates, then switch to live mode.
panel.fields.shadow: Shadow mode (record only, do not speak)
panel.fields.llm: Use a background LLM to extract interests and assess candidates
panel.fields.sourcesHelp: Uses capabilities from installed plugins only; no account cookies are read.
panel.data.title: Information the plugin actually uses
panel.data.recentConversation: New user messages from the last hour, used to extract non-sensitive interest signals.
panel.data.profile: Interest terms, positive and negative evidence, weights, and recommendation feedback, forming a small decaying profile.
panel.data.search: Titles, snippets, links, and sources returned by existing search plugins, used to build the candidate pool.
panel.data.activity: System privacy state, idle time, quiet hours, and the global proactive-chat switch, used to decide whether now is a good time.
panel.data.feedback: Replies, ignores, or rejections after recent recommendations, used for down-ranking and cooldowns.
panel.privacy.title: Information explicitly not used
panel.privacy.raw: Raw conversations are not written to long-term plugin state; only message fingerprints and extracted interests are stored.
panel.privacy.excluded: No browser history, Bilibili watch history, cookies, account favorites, or private page content is read.
panel.privacy.boundary: Sensitive health, political, religious, or financial traits are not inferred; a private foreground state blocks delivery.
panel.lastRun.title: Latest check
panel.inspection.title: Inspectable recommendation state
panel.reason.away: User has been away too long
panel.reason.interval: Too soon since the last recommendation
